problem: Internal audits depend on manual control testing, workpapers and process narratives that take auditors long hours.
product_category: AI internal audit and SOX automation

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating test plans, workpapers and flowcharts from evidence needs reliable document understanding and grounding, which is standard LLM engineering with accuracy as the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Audit workflows could create stickiness once embedded, but AuditBoard and funded startups sell similar features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: AuditBoard shipped AI audit features through 2025, so the incumbent was already moving into the wedge.

market_need_then: Internal audit teams do heavy manual work, and a 2025 Internal Audit Foundation survey cited in coverage found 40% already use generative AI and 65% plan to increase use. Several SOX automation startups raised in 2026.

branding.domain_note: Uses oxus-ai.com with an AI suffix, not oxus.com; an unrelated Lithuanian speech analytics company Oxus.AI exists and is reported shut down.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and efficiency focused; tagline 'The audit, accelerated.'

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand, and the name collides with another company using Oxus.AI.

outcome_analysis: Oxus is an active Winter 2026 company with three MIT founders automating internal audit workflows. Funding is unconfirmed, with aggregators giving amounts from 500K to 928K. The category is competitive, with AuditBoard adding AI and several funded SOX automation startups, so traction with named customers will decide the next round.
notes: Funding is unverified and conflicting: Signalbase says $650,000 pre-seed, Extruct about $928K, Neuronfeed $500K seed (January 2026), VCBacked lists YC and Toloka.vc. No primary source, so no round is recorded. The YC description names customers only generically. Outcome search found no acquisition or shutdown for this company. Name origin not found.
